name: ship-ready
description: Pre-commit / pre-distribution audit + guided cleanup. Scans the lines your changes add (or the whole repo with --full) for secrets, personal identifiers, internal hosts and private-denylist terms, provenance comments, debug leftovers, dangling references to gitignored paths, workflow/AI leakage, generated-file slop, dead config/code, and PII; stops with a fix-plan checklist you select from; then applies only the chosen fixes and hands over git/rm commands.
